sn46.40:1.1: paññānirodhikā vighātapakkhiyā → paññānirodhiyā vighāta pakkhiyā (bj) | paññānirodhikā → paññānirodhiyā (sya-all)
sn46.40:1.3: paññānirodhikaṁ → paññānirodhiyaṁ (bj, sya-all) | andhakaraṇaṁ acakkhukaraṇaṁ aññāṇakaraṇaṁ → andhakaraṇam āññāṇakaraṇam acakkhukaraṇam (pts)
sn46.40:2.4: paññābuddhiyā → paññāvuddhiyā (bj); paññāvuḍḍhiyā (sya-all) | ñāṇakaraṇā paññābuddhiyā → ñaṇakaraṇā paññavuddhiyā (pts)
sn46.40:3.3: āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā → anāvaraṇā aparihāni nīvaraṇāvaraṇā (sya-all); āvaraṇo aparihāni nīvaraṇavaraṇa (pts)
sn46.40:3.4: nīvaraṇañca → nīvaraṇena ca (sya-all) | dasāti → dasāti sāvatthi nidānaṁ (pts)
